types.FLOW: components + arrows + packets travelling between them (use a trail/cascade stack when it gets long)
types.TIME: something that happens over time (handshakes, requests, timelines): packets with chips, counters, toggles
types.SPEED: the same action at different speed/cost: packet speed, meters filling, counters ticking
types.SHAPE: two structures side by side (tables vs documents, layers, stacks): pieces pop in, one rule is broken to show the difference
types.ROLE: who does what (human vs AI): a trail of steps, each step badge-ed with who acts
types.TEXT: prompts, rules, context: bubbles, prompt cards, dashed frames, chips arriving one by one
types.RISK: outcome and danger: green check vs red cross, shield, attacker, warning badges
types.LOOP: cycles and repetition: ring/cycle icons, spinners, counters, repeated steps
